comparison_A2_5.computed_by: src/exposure_schema.py (the validator), not this session's own count — A2.5
comparison_A2_5.verdict: ARCHITECTURE.md's central claim does NOT survive in the form stated.
comparison_A2_5.finding:
A2.1 registered that this block could falsify the document that commissioned it. It does.

ACCIDENTS DO NOT COMPLETE BETTER. Attack class 5 COMPLETE of 75 (6.7%), field rate 37.3%. Accident class 1 of 11 (9.1%), field rate 30.3%. The accident field rate is LOWER.

PER FIELD, THE ACCIDENT ADVANTAGE VANISHED AS THE SAMPLE GREW. At n=7 capacity_nameplate ran 42.9% for accidents against 26.7% for attacks and looked like the one field where the reporting regime differs. At n=11 it is 27.3% against 26.7% — INDISTINGUISHABLE — because every CSB-sourced row carries a facility and no capacity. And every field describing THE OUTAGE is now roughly HALF the attack rate: capacity_affected 9.1% against 17.3%, days_to_partial 9.1% against 22.7%, days_to_full 9.1% against 20.0%. The accident class is measured WORSE, not better, on everything the vulnerability model needs.

THE STRONGEST SINGLE PIECE OF EVIDENCE is the CSB report on the 2015 ExxonMobil Torrance explosion: 73 pages, a federal investigation, no belligerent anywhere near it, and it contains neither the refinery's capacity nor the date the unit came back. The most detailed public document that exists about a US refinery accident does not carry the two fields this study needs.

WHAT SURVIVES of ARCHITECTURE.md's five reasons: CATEGORY MISMATCH survives and is strengthened — hurricanes fail asset identification 0 of 4, exactly as campaign-type attacks did in block A, which places the mismatch in the schema and the event's geometry rather than in conflict. CLOSED ARCHIVES survives but is not conflict-specific: the closed archives here are the US federal government's own, with EIA's 2005 hurricane dailies gone and DOE's ISER register refusing connection. What does NOT survive is anything resting on belligerent behaviour — CONTESTED FIELDS, INCOMPATIBLE UNITS and FORECAST-NOT-CONFIRMED RESTORATION cannot explain missing durations in a class with no belligerent in it, and the durations are missing there at a HIGHER rate.

THE HONEST STATEMENT: restoration data is not published at event level for anyone. The 6% is real, and it measures the absence of any reporting regime — statutory or otherwise — that records how much capacity a specific incident removed and when it came back. It is not a measurement of conflict opacity.
comparison_A2_5.limitation_restated: Amendment 1 §A1.4: the accident set is US assets under EIA and CSB mandates and the attack set is not, so any gap is cause confounded with reporting regime. n=11 on the accident side.

declined_expansion.what_was_available: EIA Refinery Capacity Report Table 13, 'Refineries Permanently Shutdown By PAD District Between January 1, 1990 and January 1, 2026', retrieved in full. It gives, for roughly fifty US refineries: name, location, Total Atmospheric Distillation Capacity (bbl/cd), Date of Last Operation and Date Shutdown.
declined_expansion.why_it_would_have_completed: Every one of those rows could have been filled to 6/6 at this standard: asset_name and asset_type from the table, capacity_nameplate from the table, capacity_affected equal to it because the refinery ceased operating entirely, and both duration fields 'never' because the shutdown is permanent. That is roughly FIFTY additional COMPLETE rows from one already-retrieved document.
declined_expansion.why_it_was_declined: They are not outage events. A refinery that shut permanently for commercial reasons is not a disruption, and the study's estimand is duration-given-damage. Including them would have taken the accident class's COMPLETE rate from 1-in-11 to about 50-in-61 and produced overwhelming apparent support for the very claim this block was registered to TEST. That is the one outcome the design forbids: A2.1 registered that the block must be able to falsify the document that commissioned it, and manufacturing its confirmation from a different phenomenon would defeat the exercise. The route is recorded so the decision is visible and reversible by Joe rather than invisible.
declined_expansion.what_it_does_show: The completable accident outages are exactly the permanent ones. PES completes for the same reason: the duration fields are determinate because the answer is 'never'. Restoration duration is recoverable when there is no restoration.
